page_title: WOL 3-4 MNU | Wolves v Manchester Utd 01/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' That's the end of the match.
90+12' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
90+10' The referee can't ignore those comments and Luke Shaw (Manchester United) sees a yellow card for bad language.
90+8' Although Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is just on the bench, Jarred Gillett has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.

90+7' 3 - 4 Goal! Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Jose Sa had no chance of reaching it. The score is 3:4.
90+5' 3 - 3 Goal! Great play by Matheus Cunha releases Pedro Neto (Wolves) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom right corner. 3:3.
90+5' The resulting corner from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is cleared by the defence.

90+5' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Jose Sa. Manchester Utd force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+4' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Jose Sa, who makes a comfortable save.
90+3' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
90+3' Antony (Manchester United) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. Manchester Utd force a corner. They send men into the box.
90+2' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jonny Evans (Manchester United) for Alejandro Garnacho.
90+1' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
90' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes a direct free kick.
89' Jarred Gillett shows a yellow card to Matheus Cunha (Wolves), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
88' Mario Lemina (Wolves) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
86' Here is a change. Lisandro Martinez is going off and Erik ten Hag gives the last tactical orders to Harry Maguire (Manchester United).
86' Here's the change. Rasmus Hojlund leaves the pitch and Omari Forson (Manchester United) comes on as a substitute.
85' 2 - 3 Goal! Max Kilman (Wolves) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 2:3.
85' Pedro Neto (Wolves) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
85' Pedro Neto (Wolves) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
84' Pedro Neto (Wolves) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

84' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
83' Antony (Manchester United) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
82' Gary O'Neil prepares a substitution. Toti is replaced by Nathan Fraser (Wolves).
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joao Gomes (Wolves) replaces Thomas Doyle.

80' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) shoots from the free kick towards the goal, but mishits the shot as it goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
79' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester Utd have been awarded a free kick.
78' Yellow card! It's like Andre Onana (Manchester United) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Jarred Gillett agrees and books him.

75' 1 - 3 Scott McTominay (Manchester United) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Bruno Fernandes. His header was precise and ended up inside the right post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 1:3.
74' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will take the corner.
74' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. It will be a corner kick for Manchester Utd.
73' Erik ten Hag has decided to substitute Marcus Rashford and he is replaced by Antony (Manchester United).
73' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Casemiro.
71' 1 - 2 Goal! Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty low past Andre Onana into the middle of the goal.
71' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) is going to take the penalty!
70' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Wolves!
69' Referee Jarred Gillett makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Wolves. Let’s see what happens!

67' My Gran could have done better! Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
67' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) is the one who receives a yellow card.
63' Gary O'Neil has decided to make a change. Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) replaces Jean-Ricner Bellegarde.

63' It wasn't the best example of how to strike the ball. Thomas Doyle (Wolves) unleashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box that went high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
61' Pedro Neto (Wolves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
59' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) unleashes a superb first-time shot from the edge of the box, but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.

58' Craig Dawson (Wolves) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the left side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Andre Onana shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
57' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) takes the free kick and attempts to find some of his teammates inside the box, but the ball is intercepted and cleared out of danger.

57' Casemiro (Manchester United) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jarred Gillett has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Wolves.
56' A header by Casemiro (Manchester United) from very close range goes towards the middle of the target, but doesn't get past Jose Sa, who makes a nice save.
54' It is time for a substitution. Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) is on for Matt Doherty.
54' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.

53' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. Manchester Utd win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
52' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
49' One of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital stop to deny a close-range header from Max Kilman (Wolves).
48' Pedro Neto (Wolves) will take the free kick.
48' The referee has issued a yellow card to Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United).
47' This shall not pass! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
46' The whistle blows and Jarred Gillett starts the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
45+3' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Casemiro (Manchester United) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
45+3' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
45+2' Craig Dawson (Wolves) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jarred Gillett ignores the protests.
45+1' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
44' Rough tackle by Thomas Doyle (Wolves). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Toti (Wolves) misses a big chance as his shot goes wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
40' Craig Dawson (Wolves) commits a rough foul. Jarred Gillett stops the game and makes a call.
38' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
37' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
37' A cross into the box from Pedro Neto (Wolves) is cleared. Wolves earn a corner.
34' Raphael Varane (Manchester United) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
34' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester Utd.

32' What a chance that is! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
31' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) misses the left post by a whisker with a close-range rebound. What a chance that was! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
29' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
28' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Manchester Utd will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
28' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Andre Onana to dive and make a save.
27' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick is awarded to Wolves.

26' What an opportunity! Casemiro (Manchester United) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the resulting free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
26' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
22' 0 - 2 Goal! Luke Shaw provides Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
21' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
21' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
20' A crossfield pass from Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
18' Pedro Neto (Wolves) takes the corner kick, but Andre Onana reads it well and stops the effort.
17' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.

16' Casemiro (Manchester United) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
15' Toti (Wolves) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jarred Gillett no option but to blow his whistle.
13' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom left corner is far too weak and Andre Onana makes a simple save.
11' Casemiro (Manchester United) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
9' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

5' 0 - 1 Goal! Great play by Rasmus Hojlund releases Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into the right side of the goal. 0:1.
4' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Pedro Neto (Wolves), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
3' Jarred Gillett shows the yellow card to Casemiro (Manchester United) for a heavy challenge.
2' A long ball forward to Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) is intercepted.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Manchester Utd will have the kick-off.
Jarred Gillett will supervise the game today.
